Auditleitfaden zur Optimierung von Dampfsystemen [Audit guide for the optimisation of steam systems]. klimaaktiv Energieeffiziente Betriebe. Vienna: Bundesministerium fuer Klimaschutz, Umwelt, Energie, Mobilitaet, Innovation und Technologie (BMK). Content 2017, layout December 2020. In German.

Locators are printed page numbers ("N von 80"), which equal PDF page numbers. German-language audit guide (80 pp.); labels translated. Stands in for the unavailable Carbon Trust ECG092 Steam distribution costs (carbon-trust_2004_001, cited by UKERC): its Table 11 (typical heat losses of steam and condensate pipes, W/m by nominal diameter, bare vs well insulated) and Table 2 (distribution measures recommended at 107 sites) are reprinted from Carbon Trust 2004, i.e. ECG092 itself; these went to _other-values (no parameter holds W/m) and are marked reprinted. The guide does NOT print the 8.5% distribution-system saving that UKERC row ST-D1 uses, nor any ECG092 cost figures. Main file is small (2 technologies): an illustrative boiler fuel utilisation 79-81% (Table 4) and a 9 kW deaerator vent-condenser cost example. Measure savings (Loos International 2010 Table 3, economiser, air preheat, condensing, O2 trim, blowdown flash recovery, trap maintenance) and their few costs are in _measures; costs carry no price year (2020_EUR used; underlying sources date 2008-2011). Steam trap losses by orifice and pressure (Table 13, from the 2009 ENE BREF), flash fractions, condensing potentials, O2 targets, blowdown/deaerator/radiation loss shares in _other-values. Most formulas are images (Siegert, Napier etc.) with no numeric results except Formel 23/24/34, read from page renders. TRAP: Table 9 row 100 kg/h is smaller than row 50 kg/h as printed. Table 1 (generation measures, 77 sites) is reprinted from ECG066, already extracted, so not repeated.
